properties.name: VHITS town-centre lower-speed area (C1)
properties.source: S-A04c / S-B03 p.93 (VHITS town-centre map), shading traced by S6; Inference
properties.method: Map georeferenced from three named junctions (Torrens/Seaview/Eyre roundabout, Torrens/Crozier roundabout, Coral St/Flinders Pde; residual < 5 m). The shading is traced and each side moved 10-25 m outward so the streets it is drawn along (Eyre Tce, Flinders Pde, Esplanade, Albert Pl, Crozier Rd, Torrens St) fall inside; the north-west side runs along the west kerb of Torrens St so both Torrens St carriageways are inside (C1a excludes them by name). Vertices: Torrens/Seaview/Eyre roundabout, Eyre Tce/Flinders Pde, foreshore, south-east and south-west corners on the coast, Albert Pl/Ocean St, Victoria St/Crozier Rd, Torrens/Crozier roundabout, west kerb of Torrens St.
